_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ia dados Pemain {player_id} ring permainan LinesOfAction.
Potongan tiang dados '{side}', potongan musuh dados '{other}'.
Format gerakan: `[b1b3]` (saking-koordinat nuju koordinat). Gerakan legal ngentasin horizontal, vertikal, utawi diagonal ring akeh kotak sané pateh sareng total potongan (warna anyar) ring garis punika. Ia dados melompat ring duur potongan tiang, nanging nénten ring duur potongan musuh; mendarat ring duur musuh dados nangkap.  Menang ri kala potongan tiang makejang dados hubungan 8-tetangga.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Gerak punika musti lurus utawi diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Patut magingsir jarak sané pateh sareng potongannyané.
